scenarios.description: A Godot HUD display that fails to refresh is fixed via the presentation workflow only — the executor must reproduce with a red-capable command, minimise, write a regression test, apply the smallest fix, then run targeted → architecture → full tests.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Presentation verifier and manifest tests exit 0; the fix targets the presentation workflow (frontend-godot layer) without touching SimCore game rules; evidence references the originating task.

scenarios.description: gRPC server returns map_width=0 because GameConfig is not populated — the executor must reproduce, localise to _state_to_snapshot, add a regression test, and apply the smallest fix that guarantees map_width>0 in snapshots.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Engine tests confirm state snapshots carry map_width>0; registry validator exits 0; the regression test for the gRPC snapshot field is present and green.

scenarios.description: A flaky xdist test port conflict is resolved — the executor minimises the reproducer, writes a regression test pinning the port-isolation invariant, and applies the smallest fix in the devops harness.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Devops harness tests pass (port isolation regression holds); task validator exits 0 confirming the vertical ticket fixture is well-formed; evidence is recorded in the same commit as the fix.

scenarios.description: An L1→L0 import violation (SimCore importing Agents) is detected and reversed — the executor runs the architecture lint as both the reproducer and the verifier, ensuring the layer invariant is restored.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Architecture lint exits 0 (no SimCore→Agents or L1→L0 violations); registry validator exits 0; the fix does not introduce new cross-layer dependencies.
